name: Clifton Beach (Karachi Beach)
address: Clifton Beach, Karachi, صدر ٹاؤن, ضلع کراچی, کراچی ڈویژن, سندھ, 75600, پاکستان
entryConditions: No official entry restriction found. Safety note: per Commissioner Karachi Division notification No. CK/Home Br./(Swimming)/2026-22 (dated 30-06-2026), swimming, bathing, diving and wading were completely banned along the sea coast and beaches within Karachi Division from 01.07.2026 to 23.08.2026 under Section 144 Cr.P.C.; the ban had expired by the verification date, but such bans are re-imposed seasonally on drowning advisories from the Pakistan Maritime Security Agency.
description: Clifton Beach is a named beach on Karachi's Arabian Sea coast in the Clifton area, mapped in OpenStreetMap as a point feature in Saddar Town, Karachi Division. The Cantonment Board Clifton is listed among the authorities copied on the 2026 Karachi beach swimming-ban notification for this coastline. No official page states opening hours or entry fees for the beach.
sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Clifton_Beach,_Karachi_-_Pakistan.jpg (photo; metadata read via en.wikipedia.org action API imageinfo)
notes: OSM maps Clifton Beach as a node (point), not a shoreline way, so the node coordinates were used directly. A beach is a line, not a point: the node sits on the mapped shoreline near the Clifton/Sea View end of the coast. Hours and prices left null: no official authority page (Sindh Tourism, City Government Karachi, KPT) stating 'free and openly accessible' could be found; stdc.gov.pk and tourism.sindh.gov.pk were unreachable and stdc.org.pk is a different organisation (Science & Technology Development Council). Photo depicts Clifton Beach per its Commons description ('Under-construction high-rises at Clifton Beach, Karachi', taken 2019).

name: Sea View (Seaface / Boat Basin stretch)
address: Seaview Beach, صدر ٹاؤن, ضلع کراچی, کراچی ڈویژن, سندھ, 75600, پاکستان
entryConditions: No official entry restriction found. The Commissioner Karachi Division swimming-ban notification No. CK/Home Br./(Swimming)/2026-22 (01.07.2026-23.08.2026, Section 144 Cr.P.C.) applies to beaches within the territorial limits of Karachi Division, which includes this stretch.
description: Seaview Beach is a named beach point on Karachi's coast in Saddar Town, mapped in OpenStreetMap east of Clifton along the Sea View/Seaface shore. The adjacent Boat Basin is separately mapped in OSM as a bay feature (way/712243900, centre 24.821449, 67.018304). No official page states opening hours or entry fees for the beach.
sources: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=Boat+Basin+Karachi&format=jsonv2&addressdetails=1&limit=3 (Boat Basin bay feature cited in notes)
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HorseBeach.jpg (photo; source-file title is 'Sea View, Karachi', metadata read via en.wikipedia.org action API imageinfo)
notes: 'Sea View' is a shoreline stretch, not a point; coordinates anchored to the OSM node 'Seaview Beach' on the mapped shoreline. A Nominatim query for 'Sea View Point Karachi' returned zero results; 'Seaview Beach Karachi' returned the node used here. The photo's original Flickr title is 'Sea View, Karachi' by Bilal Mirza, so it depicts this specific stretch rather than generic coastline. Hours/prices null: no official statement found.

name: Hawksbay Beach
address: ہاکس بے بیچ, کیماڑی ٹاؤن, ضلع کیماڑی, کراچی ڈویژن, سندھ, پاکستان
entryConditions: No official entry restriction found. The Commissioner Karachi Division swimming-ban notification No. CK/Home Br./(Swimming)/2026-22 (01.07.2026-23.08.2026, Section 144 Cr.P.C.) prohibits swimming, bathing, diving and wading at beaches within Karachi Division, including this beach; the notification cites drowning incidents at Karachi beaches reported by the Pakistan Maritime Security Agency.
description: Hawksbay Beach is a Karachi coastline beach in Keamari Town, mapped in OpenStreetMap as a shoreline way (natural=beach) spanning roughly 7 km. The published coordinates are the south-eastern end of that mapped line, the end nearest the inland road network on the Sandspit/Scheme 42 side. No official page states opening hours or entry fees for the beach.
sources: https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/516419993/full (shoreline geometry used to pick the access-point anchor)
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HawksBay_Beach.jpg (photo; file is categorised 'Hawksbay Beach, Karachi' on Commons, metadata read via en.wikipedia.org action API imageinfo)
notes: The beach is a line, not a point: a Nominatim query for 'Hawksbay Beach Karachi' returned zero results, so the Urdu-named way 'ہاکس بے بیچ' was used. Coordinates anchored to the easternmost node of the OSM beach way (bounding box 24.8432-24.8628, 66.8303-66.8987), the end closest to the mainland road network leading from the Sandspit/Hawksbay-village side; no named parking or jetty feature exists in OSM for this beach. Overpass API (overpass-api.de and mirrors) was unreachable from this network (TLS handshake blocked), so the raw OSM API was used for geometry. Hours/prices null: no official statement found.

name: Sandspit Beach
address: Sandspit, کیماڑی ٹاؤن, ضلع کیماڑی, کراچی ڈویژن, سندھ, پاکستان
entryConditions: No official entry restriction found. The Commissioner Karachi Division swimming-ban notification No. CK/Home Br./(Swimming)/2026-22 (01.07.2026-23.08.2026, Section 144 Cr.P.C.) prohibits swimming, bathing, diving and wading at beaches within Karachi Division, including this beach.
description: Sandspit is a beach on the Karachi coastline in Keamari Town, mapped in OpenStreetMap as a shoreline way (natural=beach) spanning roughly 5 km between Hawksbay and the Manora causeway side. The published coordinates are the point on that shoreline nearest the 'Sandspit beach' access point mapped on Sandspit Road. No official page states opening hours or entry fees for the beach.
sources: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=Sandspit+Beach+Karachi&format=jsonv2&addressdetails=1&limit=3 (camp-site access POI node/6593664185 on Sandspit Road)
https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/516413062/full (shoreline geometry used to pick the access-point anchor)
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sandspit_beach_karachi.jpg (photo; description names Sandspit beach, metadata read via en.wikipedia.org action API imageinfo)
notes: The beach is a line, not a point: coordinates anchored to the node of OSM way 516413062 closest (~40 m) to node 6593664185, a 'Sandspit beach' POI on سینڈ اسپٹ روڈ (Sandspit Road), i.e. the mapped road-side access point. Photo selection was deliberately strict: Commons searches for 'Sandspit Beach' also return Mudeford Sandspit images from England, which were rejected; the chosen file is explicitly titled and described as Sandspit beach, Karachi. Hours/prices null: no official statement found.

name: Manora (island village and Manora Point beach)
address: منوڑا, کیماڑی ٹاؤن, ضلع کیماڑی, کراچی ڈویژن, سندھ, 75640, پاکستان
entryConditions: No official page stating entry conditions or fees for Manora beach could be found. The Commissioner Karachi Division swimming-ban notification No. CK/Home Br./(Swimming)/2026-22 (01.07.2026-23.08.2026, Section 144 Cr.P.C.) applies to beaches within Karachi Division; the notification is copied to the Cantonment Executive Officer, Cantonment Board Clifton, Manora & Korangi Creek, indicating a cantonment authority administers the Manora area.
description: Manora is an island settlement in Karachi's Keamari District, mapped in OpenStreetMap as a suburb centred on the published coordinates. Its shoreline beach is mapped as a separate OSM way (منوڑا بیچ, way/516413057, bounding box 24.792-24.806, 66.957-66.977, roughly 2.5 km long), and a slipway named 'PNS Qasim New Jetty' (way/1280095712, 24.7943655, 66.9788057) is mapped on the island's eastern side. No official source confirming a current ferry service or its price was found.
sources: https://commissionerkarachi.gos.pk/uploads/1783601323_bc1970467658df698ebc.pdf (entryConditions: swimming ban notification; Cantonment Board Manora & Korangi Creek as copy recipient)
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Manora_Beach,_Karachi,_Pakistan.jpg (photo; categorised 'Manora Beach' on Commons, metadata read via en.wikipedia.org action API imageinfo)
notes: Published coordinates are the OSM suburb node for the Manora island settlement itself; the beach is a ~2.5 km shoreline way (516413057) and 'Manora Point' returned no result in Nominatim, so no separate point is claimed for it. Boat access: the only jetty-like feature found in OSM is the 'PNS Qasim New Jetty' slipway on the island's east side; Karachi Port Trust's site (kpt.gov.pk) mentions Manora only in its history pages and no official page states a boat/ferry fare from Boat Basin or Hawke's Bay, so ticketPrices is null and no crossing price is published. The Commons photo shows Manora beach and is categorised 'Manora Beach' (its description also notes the island is connected to the mainland by a long causeway).
